# Adani Ports & SEZ Q2 FY27 profit up 16.5%

## Revenue from operations rose 24% y-o-y to ₹11,340 crore, driven by strong performance across all segments

### By BL Ahmedabad Bureau

Updated - October 28, 2026 at 01:59 PM.

Driven by broad-based growth across its domestic and international ports, logistics and marine businesses, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) reported a 16.5 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated profit to ₹3,622 crore in the second quarter of FY27.

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd. reported a 16.5% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, supported by growth across its ports, logistics and marine businesses, while raising its full-year revenue and Ebitda guidance following a strong first half.

Net profit for the quarter rose to Rs 3,622 crore from Rs 3,109 crore a year earlier. Revenue increased 23.7% to Rs 11,340 crore, while Ebitda rose 22.6% to Rs 6,806 crore. EBITDA Margin stood at 60%.
